description: This walk takes you from the popular town of Filey to the Bempton Cliffs RSPB reserve. The trail runs for a distance of 8 miles, passing along the waymarked England Coast Path. There are some moderate climbs with tremendous views from the elevated cliff top paths. Starting on the sea front in Filey you head south along the lovely Hunmanby Sands. You continue past Speeton Cliffs before coming to Bempton Cliffs where you can look out for a wide variety of seabirds. You can continue your walking by visiting the nearby Flamborough Head on the Flamborough to Bempton Cliffs Walk .
